# How to Check and Solve WearEngine issue: Scope unauthorized

[![ZhangAnmy](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fill:64:64/1*u1jTlAwFzhutyagjcEqFZg.jpeg)](https://medium.com/@zhanganmy01?source=post_page---byline--412f5d5668ee-----------------------------------------)

[ZhangAnmy](https://medium.com/@zhanganmy01?source=post_page---byline--412f5d5668ee-----------------------------------------)

Follow

3 min read

·

Sep 5, 2021

50

1

[Listen](https://medium.com/m/signin?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmedium.com%2Fplans%3Fdimension%3Dpost_audio_button%26postId%3D412f5d5668ee&operation=register&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fmedium.com%2Fhuawei-developers%2Fhow-to-check-and-solve-wearengine-issue-scope-unauthorized-412f5d5668ee&source=---header_actions--412f5d5668ee---------------------post_audio_button--------------------)

Share

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*06zWCKm5YwP3GwVz.png)

**Introduction**: When mobile and HarmonyOS watch communicate with each other, sometimes “Scope unauthorized”comes from mobile side. This article will introduce how to check and solve the issue step by step.

The log detail for the issue:

```
2021-06-07 18:21:14.628 27759-27993/com.test D/WearEngine_DeviceServiceProxy: enter syncCheckConnStatus
2021-06-07 18:21:14.628 27759-27993/com.test D/WearEngine_DeviceServiceProxy: syncCheckConnStatusm DeviceManager is not null.
2021-06-07 18:21:14.740 27759-27759/com.test I/TAG: getBondedDevices task submission error: Scope unauthorized
2021-06-07 18:21:14.740 27759-27759/com.test D/TAG: getAuthClient onFailure Scope unauthorized
```

There are **6 parts** need to check as followings:

Please make sure the wearable device is connected to mobile HiHealth.

1. **On Mobile side**, the project code should configure wearable packagename and fingerprint information in below code, please following below link to check the wearable package name and fingerprint are right or not?

[Obtaining a Signing Certificate Fingerprint on the Wearable Device](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/development/connectivity-Guides/signature-0000001053969657)

```
private static final String WEARABLE_PACKAGE_NAME = "com.huawei.watchdemo";
private static final String WEARABLE_FINGERPRINT = "com.huawei.watchdemo_BAX3A0epnNuCaV7qyEjyldpdWkeRsRDewMU/GZh1QeUnGmtDG0IjW27KwNRmXIm08DMNlEfWt536VnXXXXXXXXX=";
```

2\. **On Wearable side**, the project code should configure as below, please follow the link [Generating a Signing Certificate Fingerprint](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/codelab/HMSPreparation/index.html#3) to check Mobile side fingerprint is correct or not?

```
private static final String PHONE_PEER_PACKAGE = "com.huawei.anmywatchdemo01";//This is the mobile apk pacakge name,it should be different with wearable package name
private static final String PHONE_FINGERPRINT = "F85488DE205EC95AC98AA4DA45FC6779213196AFDF23E63744F0D77XXXXXXXXX";
```

3\. Check APPID and package name of the Mobile project are same as applied Wearengine service or not. Please following the link in [AGC Wear Engine](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/console#/serviceCards/AppService) to check them.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*jLNisCLFM-kDgiRf0OZBNQ.png)

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*GOIlhrd_MC7xNd4xFUk5dw.png)

4\. Check the SHA256 fingerprint configured in [AGC Account](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/console#/serviceCards/AppService) is same as Mobile project(mobile project name is: com.huawei.anmywatchdemo01) or not

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*0DxSn8UVOX2KknIxfR6HLg.png)

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*GHCSJX94mwe1N-qRAUHmNA.png)

5\. Please make sure the SHA256 fingerprint of .jks or .keystore file used in mobile project is same as above.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*iP9BNv9TLCQs1Pnm2hu5-g.png)

Use command to get SHA256 fingerprint of .jks file: keytool -list -v -keystore C:\\xxx.jks

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*RmbsFIeMF8ww6ynBlPSkvA.png)

**Note**: If developer uses default keystore file of Android, please find the debug.keystore file in folder: C:\\Users\\$username\\.android

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*4cTNwMTKiKg2x2rw0C6uIw.png)

6\. After check above all the information are correct, if the error “Scope unauthorized” still there. Please following the link [Wear Engine FAQs](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/development/connectivity-Guides/faq-0000001050818031) to clear data or reinstall Huawei Health.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/1*JOZr8XAg_Rbv2ZeR5lrSCg.png)

**Conclusion**

## Get ZhangAnmy’s stories in your inbox

Join Medium for free to get updates from this writer.

Subscribe

Subscribe

Remember me for faster sign in

This article shows the steps for checking the error “ **Scope unauthorized**” for Wear Engine. Based on above steps, the issue will be solved basically. One of the developers has this issue when **etract and install .apk from .aab in google PlayStore**. I will post another article to clear the issue under this scenario.

**Reference**

1. [Obtaining a Signing Certificate Fingerprint on the Wearable Device](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/development/connectivity-Guides/signature-0000001053969657)
2. [Generating a Signing Certificate Fingerprint](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/codelab/HMSPreparation/index.html#3)
3. [Wear Engine FAQs](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/development/connectivity-Guides/faq-0000001050818031)

# Testing Wear Engine on Huawei Watch GT Runner?

passe\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*@\*\*\*il.com

Lv 0

Asked May 15, 2022 at 17:53

924

Unanswered

Latest edited May 15, 2022 at 17:53

Hello,

I'd like to build a watch app that displays information sent from a corresponding phone app. Unfortunately, my Huawei Watch GT Runner does not appear to have a developer mode or any other way of installing an in-development app onto it for testing. My questions:

- Is there a way to install an in-development (not released) app on a GT Runner?
- If not, is there a way for a real-world phone to send information to the in-development app running on a watch emulator in DevEco?
- If not, is there a way to run both a phone and a watch emulator simultaneously and have them communicate?

Any help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

3 replies

Active

![header](https://upfile7.hicloud.com/FileServer/image/1000.A0sy7Y74qo8Nd-WI8eHl3A.QvLdSxzaFH_Hb8WPIWv-fEJsSabYbvvAqKkIOiueCpaGO7bpKz_lX4A49UceqbT1uKXo8GBEUJwwbixuBCHwF4To3WhaXGhpMSs6OyVyHwx4Yc_YbQ.jpg)

Si

Lv 0

#2 \| Replied Mar 31, 2023 at 20:01

Hi Boris,

I'm trying to do the same thing, and I was wondering, do I have to go through the approval process to use the Wear Engine just to write a test app on my phone that will communication with my GT3 watch?

It seems like an awful lot to go through just to write a simple test app, and it's very badly documented. I came to a complete halt when it was expecting me to upload excel documents - I have no idea what to send them - this is just an app to test the communication with my watch....

Regards,

Simon

Comment

0

Boris

#1 \| Replied May 16, 2022 at 08:09

Hello there,

My name is Boris and I am one of the moderators. I have talked with watch expert and this is what I got from them:

In order to install a watch app on the GT Runner, please follow these instructions about running an app on a Lite Wearable device:

https://developer.harmonyos.com/en/docs/documentation/doc-guides/run\_fitnesswatch-0000001054134240

Also follow the links there to correctly sign the HAP generated, so it can be installed on your test device.

For sending messages between a real phone and a real watch, the Wear Engine can be used: https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/hms/huawei-wearengine/

Right now it does not seem to be possible to communicate between a real phone and an emulator watch. But this has not been confirmed as developer did not have time to test the communication on the spot.

Regards,

Boris

**Hey Huaweians,**

As world is still going through the pandemic and daily activities coming to a halt. It is now more important than ever to take good care of your health by maintaining physical activites.

**Huawei has a series of Smart bands and Smart Watches that can help you monitor your health 24x7 and the data gets synced with the Huawei Health App after sometime so that you may access it whenever you need.**

Huawei Health App comes built-in with Huawei and Honor Smartphones but in case you are a non Huawei Android Smartphone user, you need to download the Health and AppGallery App in order to pair your Smart Fitness Device with your Health App.

You can acquire following benefits using Huawei Health App:

**⚫ Pair and manage your HUAWEI/HONOR wearable devices**

**⚫ Record daily data of your steps, calories, and exercises**

**⚫ View your outdoor running trajectory**

**⚫ Customize your own running plan**

**⚫ Share your workout data with friends**

To download and connect with Huawei Health App from a Non Huawei Device, perform the following steps:

▶ Visit [https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10132067](https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10132067 "https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10132067"), to download and install Huawei HMS Core apk

▶ Visit [https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10414141](https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10414141 "https://appgallery.cloud.huawei.com/appdl/C10414141"), to download and install Huawei Health apk

▶ Once you have downloaded and installed both Huawei HMS Core and Huawei Health App, simply open your Huawei Health App and follow the mentioned steps below to add a new Smart Health Monitoring Huawei/Honor Device:

![](https://communityfile-dre.op.hicloud.com/FileServer/getFile/cmtybbs/000/092/991/98DFA3AF7C4347E489B50B8ED114F4A8:19E53809BA5C5EAEBD0A466C2D1A527DA31EFC096928F6B8A83C55BEA2B2489B.20200907064705.67820553779349842477936236175227:50001231000000:2800:3CCA035F85283C36F39629647350F9982E50EA40F2E106478913362A6BE0C151.jpg)
